title: timeline: consecutive snapshots to one row per process per interval
body: Pure. For each process seen in both of two snapshots: concurrency = delta cpu_ns / delta wall_ns, threads alive, rss. A process first seen in a snapshot credits everything it has consumed so far to that interval, since its start time says when it began. A process that is gone from the later snapshot has its last interval lost; the summary reports the gap against rusage. Unit tests on hand-built snapshots.
